title: Delightful New Potato Delight
description: A simple and flavorful side dish that brings out the natural sweetness of new potatoes. Perfect for a quick snack or as a side for any meal.
instructions: Wash and dry the new potatoes thoroughly.
Poke some holes in each potato with a fork.
Rub the potatoes with a little bit of oil and sprinkle with salt.
Place the potatoes on a baking sheet.
Bake for 45-60 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork.
While the potatoes are baking, heat a skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped Nutty Delight to the skillet and toast until fragrant.
Once the potatoes are done, remove them from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Slice the potatoes in half lengthwise and serve with the toasted Nutty Delight.
